card.name: The digit 3 inside phone and ZIP numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 3 (sometimes 8) in the middle of a phone number, ZIP code or verse number, right after a prefix such as 631- or 378. Also fires on 'wn' in the name Drewnowsky.

modes.label: Digit in phone number
modes.description: A 3 at the start of the middle group of a phone number after an area code.

modes.label: Digit in ZIP or reference number
modes.description: A 3 or 8 inside a ZIP code, scripture verse or ISBN.

modes.label: Inside a surname
modes.description: The 'wn' piece in the name Drewnowsky.
